Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's alright.
Q: That's fine, we can skip that part for now. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was in a parking lot near a shopping center in Conroe, Texas. I was pulling out of a space near the main
entrance.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I had my reverse lights on and was backing slowly. I was looking over my right shoulder when the other car came
down the lane. I didn't see it until it was almost on me.
Q: How fast would you estimate the other vehicle was moving?
A: Not fast, maybe walking speed or a little quicker. It still hit my rear quarter panel hard enough to push me back a
bit.
Q: Did you get out of your vehicle right away?
A: Yes, but my right knee gave out when I stepped down. I had to hold onto the door frame.
Q: Can you describe the knee injury?
A: It's swollen and I have trouble bending it. Stairs are the worst. I went to urgent care that afternoon and they told me
to follow up with an orthopedic doctor.
Q: Have you had any prior problems with that knee?
A: I had some stiffness years ago after playing softball, but nothing that kept me from working or driving.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt at the time of the collision?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the incident?
A: Just that I'm still dealing with the pain and I'm not sure how long the treatment will take.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Okay, thanks.
</page>
